title: Data Engineer
description: Developed scalable ETL pipelines using Apache Spark and Python to process and transform large volumes of insurance, retirement, and asset-management data including policy transactions, annuity contributions, claims activity, and market reference data. Utilized SQL and Hive to design optimized data models and complex analytical queries for policyholder, portfolio, and fund-level analysis. Built predictive models using TensorFlow and Scikit-learn to forecast policy lapse risk, annuity withdrawal behavior, and investment portfolio volatility. Designed and maintained entity-relationship (ER) diagrams for core business entities, improving schema efficiency by 30%. Implemented Apache Airflow DAGs to automate daily and intraday processing of claims and investment performance data. Optimized data ingestion by partitioning large fact tables, achieving 20% reduction in ETL runtime and up to 50% faster query performance. Created Power BI dashboards to visualize policy performance, investment returns, risk exposure, and customer behavior insights. Leveraged AWS Glue for serverless ETL orchestration and metadata management, reducing manual intervention by 40%.

title: Data Engineer
description: Led design, development, and optimization of data pipelines using PySpark, SQL, Azure Databricks, and Synapse Analytics. Developed modular and reusable Python scripts to automate complex ETL processes for financial datasets including transactions, portfolio data, and reconciliation logs. Migrated large datasets from Teradata and PostgreSQL to Azure Synapse using Data Factory, Blob Storage, and PolyBase. Integrated HDFS as a staging layer for large-scale data ingestion. Built reusable Normalization Framework in Azure Databricks to standardize transformations across multiple data sources. Created Inventory Reconciliation Automation Framework reducing manual effort by 70%. Built a Migration UI Tool to automate transformation logic from model v1.0 to v2.0. Collaborated with business analysts and finance teams to translate requirements into Tableau visualizations aligned with KPIs. Secured data flows using Apache NiFi's built-in role-based access control (RBAC). Applied MapReduce techniques to identify data mismatches, saving 40% of manual audit effort. Implemented normalized and denormalized data models for both operational and analytical workloads.
